Fields.Name: Camera Target X
Fields.Description: X of the point the camera looks at, in metres in the model's space.

Fields.Name: Camera Target Y
Fields.Description: Height of the point the camera looks at, in metres in the model's space.

Fields.Name: Camera Target Z
Fields.Description: Z of the point the camera looks at, in metres in the model's space.

Fields.Name: Camera Distance
Fields.Description: Starting distance from the camera to the target point, in metres.

Fields.Name: Camera Pitch
Fields.Description: Starting vertical angle of the camera around the target, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Camera Yaw
Fields.Description: Starting horizontal angle of the camera around the target, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Camera Field of View
Fields.Description: Camera field of view, in degrees.

Fields.Name: Camera Distance: Minimum
Fields.Description: Closest the player can zoom the camera, in metres. Zoom input is clamped between the minimum and maximum.

Fields.Name: Camera Distance: Maximum
Fields.Description: Farthest the player can zoom the camera, in metres.

Fields.Name: Camera Pitch: Minimum
Fields.Description: Lowest pitch the player can turn the camera to, in degrees. Pitch input is clamped between the minimum and maximum; yaw turns freely.

Fields.Name: Camera Pitch: Maximum
Fields.Description: Highest pitch the player can turn the camera to, in degrees.

Fields.Name: GPARAM ID
Fields.Description: Drawing parameter (GPARAM) set used to light this render.

Fields.Name: Environment Map ID
Fields.Description: Environment map texture used for reflections, loaded as GILM<ID>_rem (4 digits).

Fields.Name: GPARAM ID: PS4
Fields.Description: GPARAM ID used instead on PS4.

Fields.Name: GPARAM ID: Xbox One
Fields.Description: GPARAM ID used instead on Xbox One.
